title: HIV infection screening in adolescents and adults aged 15 to 65 years

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends that clinicians screen for HIV infection in adolescents and adults aged 15 to 65 years.

denominator.quote: adolescents and adults aged 15 to 65 years

numerator.note: No screening interval is stated in this section; no lookback window applied (any HIV test on record). Interval logic is deferred to Clinical Considerations, not provided here.
